title: ScoringBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Tabular Foundation Models with Proper Scoring Rules
abstract: arXiv:2603.29928v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tabular foundation models such as TabPFN, TabICL, ExaOneTabular, and Nori already produce full predictive distributions, yet prevailing regression benchmarks evaluate them almost exclusively via point-estimate metrics such as RMSE. This overlooks the distributional information these models are designed to provide. We introduce ScoringBench, an open and extensible benchmark that evaluates tabular regression models under a comprehensive suite of proper scoring rules - including (weighted) CRPS, energy scores and interval scores - alongside standard point metrics. ScoringBench covers 101 regression datasets from diverse domains, supports transparent community contributions via a git-based leaderboard, and provides two complementary ranking protocols: an ordinal Demsar/autorank approach and a magnitude-preserving $z$-score ranking approach. translated_title: ScoringBench：一个使用恰当评分规则评估表格基础模型的基准测试
translated_abstract: 诸如 TabPFN、TabICL、ExaOneTabular 和 Nori 等表格基础模型已经能够产生完整的预测分布，然而主流的回归基准测试几乎仅通过 RMSE 等点估计指标来评估它们，这忽视了这些模型旨在提供的分布信息。我们推出了 ScoringBench，一个开放且可扩展的基准测试，它在标准点指标之外，使用一整套恰当评分规则——包括（加权）CRPS、能量得分和区间得分——来评估表格回归模型。ScoringBench 涵盖来自不同领域的 101 个回归数据集，支持通过基于 git 的排行榜进行透明的社区贡献，并提供两种互补的排名协议：序数型 Demsar/autorank 方法以及保留量级差异的 z 分数排名方法。我们对多种模型类型进行了评估，包括（经过微调的）表格基础模型、梯度……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 ScoringBench，首个基于恰当评分规则（如加权 CRPS、能量得分和区间得分）的开放可扩展基准测试，弥补了现有基准仅用点估计指标评估的不足，能够全面评估表格基础模型所产生预测分布的质量。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces ScoringBench, an open and extensible benchmark that, for the first time, evaluates the full predictive distributions of tabular foundation models using proper scoring rules—including weighted CRPS, energy scores, and interval scores—across 101 regression datasets, addressing the limitations of point-estimate-only evaluation in existing benchmarks.
